title: Bupleurum chinense DC. reduces LPS-induced neuroinflammation in rats by activating CREB and suppressing NF-kappaB and TNF-alpha protein expression.
authors: Wang, Huan-Huan; Chang, Bai-Jin; Liu, Yan-Ru; Tang, Zhi-Shu; Song, Zhong-Xing; Shi, Xin-Bo; Liu, Hong-Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药柴胡通过NF-kappaB/TNF-alpha/CREB通路减轻大鼠神经炎症，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Bupleurum chinense DC., is traditionally used for "soothing the liver qi and relieving depression." In traditional Chinese medicine theory, liver qi stagnation is often associated with emotional disturbances and mental depression, which modern research suggests may involve the underlying neuroinflammatory processes. This study evaluated its anti-neuroinflammatory effects and identified key mechanisms to elucidate its traditional use. OBJECTIVE OF THE RESEARCH: This study aimed to examine the principal bioactive compounds in Bupleurum chinense DC. and their modulatory effects on neuroinflammation via the NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, CREB signaling pathways. MATERIALS AND METHODS: UPLC-MS/MS and network pharmacology were used to identify the chemical constituents and predict the anti-inflammatory targets of Bupleurum chinense DC. A lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced rat model was evaluated using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and hematoxylin and eosin staining. Metabolomic analysis was performed to elucidate primary metabolic pathways. Subsequently, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, Western blotting (WB), and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) were performed to validate the key components and targets. RESULTS: Through UPLC-MS/MS analysis, saikosaponin A, quercetin, rutin, saikosaponin C, and saikosaponin D were identified as key active compounds in Bupleurum chinense DC. Experimental results from inflammatory rat models demonstrated that Bupleurum chinense DC. ameliorates LPS-induced neuroinflammation. Metabolomic analysis revealed biomarkers associated with the TNF-alpha signaling pathway and identified TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, and CREB as core therapeutic targets. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations confirmed the stability of compound-target interactions. Finally, ELISA, WB and RT-qPCR analyses confirmed that Bupleurum chinense DC. modulates NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and CREB in a dose-dependent manner, thereby mechanistically establishing its neuroprotective effects. CONCLUSION: Bupleurum chinense DC. mitigated inflammation by upregulating CREB protein expression and downregulating NF-kappaB and TNF-alpha within the TNF-alpha signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：柴胡（Bupleurum chinense DC.）传统上用于“疏肝解郁”。在中医理论中，肝气郁结常与情绪失调和精神抑郁相关，现代研究提示这可能涉及潜在的神经炎症过程。本研究评估了其抗神经炎症作用，并确定了关键机制以阐明其传统用途。研究目的：本研究旨在考察柴胡中的主要生物活性化合物及其通过NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、CREB信号通路对神经炎症的调节作用。材料与方法：采用UPLC-MS/MS和网络药理学方法鉴定柴胡的化学成分并预测其抗炎靶点。通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）和苏木精-伊红染色评估脂多糖（LPS）诱导的大鼠模型。进行代谢组学分析以阐明主要代谢途径。随后，采用分子对接、分子动力学模拟、Western blotting（WB）和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）验证关键成分和靶点。结果：通过UPLC-MS/MS分析，柴胡皂苷A、槲皮素、芦丁、柴胡皂苷C和柴胡皂苷D被鉴定为柴胡中的关键活性化合物。炎症大鼠模型的实验结果表明，柴胡可改善LPS诱导的神经炎症。代谢组学分析揭示了与TNF-alpha信号通路相关的生物标志物，并确定TNF-alpha、NF-kappaB和CREB为核心治疗靶点。分子对接和动力学模拟确认了化合物-靶点相互作用的稳定性。最后，ELISA、WB和RT-qPCR分析证实，柴胡以剂量依赖性方式调节NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha和CREB，从而在机制上确立其神经保护作用。结论：柴胡通过上调CREB蛋白表达并下调TNF-alpha信号通路中的NF-kappaB和TNF-alpha来减轻炎症。
